Name: (AT) Hitme's Spouse Portraits Reworked
Author: Hitme11
Description:
This is an Alternative Texture (AT) conversion of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22912?tab=description]this mod[/url], both were originally created and currently maintained by me (Hitme11).

[b]Mod description:[/b]
[quote][i]﻿I found new 1.6 vanilla portraits are bland and boring because they looks exactly the same for everyone, which remind me of my passport photo (lol), so I remade them into portraits that I imagined they would want to take.[/i][/quote]
﻿- Easier packs will be update later.

[color=#ff7700][b]INSTRUCTION (please read carefully):[/b][/color]
[color=#f4f4f4]- Step 1: Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Texture﻿[/url][/color]
﻿- Step 2: Download and install AT pack(s) that you want to use (choose anything you like, they don't really overlap)
﻿ ﻿+ [AT] Spouse Portraits Reworked - Vanillia: all vanilla spouses.
﻿ ﻿+ [AT] SVE Spouse Portraits Reworked - Vanillia: all SVE spouses, require [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url].
﻿ ﻿+ [AT] SVE Rasmodia Portraits Reworked - Vanilla: for Rasmodia, require [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8265]Romanceable Rasmodia[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url].
﻿ ﻿+ [AT] Non-SVE Rasmodius Spouse Portraits Reworked: for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21607]Nom0ri's Romanceable Rasmodius - Updated[/url], contains Rasmodius portraits.
﻿ ﻿+ [AT] Non-SVE Rasmodia Spouse Portraits Reworked: for Rasmodia, require [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21607]Nom0ri's Romanceable Rasmodius - Updated[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8265]Romanceable Rasmodia[/url].
﻿ ﻿+ [AT] Adarin Spouse Portraits Reworked: for Adarin Bachelors to Bachelorettes.

[color=#ff7700][b]FAQ:[/b][/color]
[color=#f4f4f4][b]- ﻿Q: Is the original mod (CP) Hitme's Spouse Reworked dead/not supported in the future?[/b][/color]
﻿[color=#f4f4f4]- A: No, they're both supported and updated at the same time. This one is just for people who want to use with AT.[/color]

[b]﻿- Q: Why did you make them a seperate modpage? Why not just upload them as optional files?[/b]
[color=#f4f4f4]- A: The CP version is somewhat highly configurable, I can compress all of them into one main CP file then add configs for people to choose which they want in their game. AT doesn't work like that, AT packs don't have config.json file, so everything I put in AT folder, including all of the alternative one (like bachelors to bachelorettes, recolor, frame material, styles, etc.) will flood into AT system once the pack is loaded, and some people won't like it when their husband became a girl (lol). With that in mind, I find the best solution is to split them into several small AT packs for people to choose from (recolor version, bachelors to bachelorettes version,...). AT packs have their own manifest that will be update individually and I can control how many of them on this page. ﻿
﻿[/color][b]TL;DR: I don't want to upload 4 or 5 AT packs that would cause confusion for people on the main modpage, as they may not familiar with AT)[/b]
﻿
[b]﻿- Q: Is there any other reason?[/b]
[color=#f4f4f4]- A: Honestly, yes. Both AT and CP have different features. For example, I uploaded an AT called "(AT) Easier Spouse Portraits Reworked", this version add all of the portraits as alternative textures for one painting that can be easily obtained through catalogue. So with that pack, you can have [/color][b]both Abigail and Leah portraits at the same time in the same save file, no need to see their 14 hearts events.[/b][color=#f4f4f4] On the other hand, CP version is easier to support collaboration with other mods, so somebody or me can make a patch to replace my portraits if both mods are installed. CP also provides specific feature like dynamic and seasonal portrait frame,... 
﻿[/color][color=#f4f4f4]TL;DR: You don't need to (and[/color][color=#ff0000] not recommended to[/color][color=#f4f4f4]) use them both, but both have pros/cons. CP is the main mod with collab support. 

[/color][b]CREDITS:[/b]
- FlashShifter's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] for all SVE spouse character sprites.
﻿- Nom0ri's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8265]Romanceable Rasmodia[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21607]Romanceable Rasmodius - Updated[/url] for Rasmodia and Rasmodius character sprites.
